questions.q_en: I see you only have physical biosafety and no engineered containment method. Why?
questions.q_zh: 我看到你們只有物理性的生物安全，沒有任何基因層面的圍阻機制。為什麼？
kw_en: a pore does not depend on genotype
kw_zh: 多層是規劃中，不是現在就有
questions.a_en: Because Dr. Jennifer Brophy told us to make physical containment the primary mechanism rather than relying on a kill switch, and we took it: a biological switch is a piece of DNA under selection, so it mutates and fails, while a 0.2 micrometre pore does not depend on the organism's genotype at all. In our architecture the barrier is also the product path, so monitoring the membrane is monitoring containment — which is why transmembrane pressure, flow and leak detection are on the instrument list, and why a plate is required after every module change. A kill step sitting on that path would also have to be kept away from the protein we are trying to harvest. I will not claim this is finished: the planned layers are a pressure trip that stops the pump and opens the pinch valve, and a droplet sensor under the loop, and genetic containment sits on the 2027 roadmap.
questions.a_zh: 因為 Jennifer Brophy 博士建議我們把物理圍阻當成主要機制，而不是依賴自殺開關，而我們接受了：生物性的開關是一段處在選擇壓力下的 DNA，所以它會突變、會失效，而 0.2 微米的孔徑完全不依賴生物體的基因型。在我們的架構裡，那道屏障同時也是產品路徑，所以監看膜就等於監看圍阻——這也是為什麼跨膜壓、流量和洩漏偵測都在儀器清單上，以及為什麼每次換模組之後都必須塗一次盤。而一個放在那條路徑上的滅殺步驟，還得想辦法不要碰到我們正要採收的蛋白。我不會說這件事已經完成：規劃中的層次是「會停泵並打開夾管閥的壓力跳脫」和「迴路下方的液滴感測器」，而基因層面的圍阻在 2027 年的路線圖上。
questions.trap_en: Present tense on the layers. Entrepreneurship says redundancy with genetic and membrane containment and schedules kill switches for 2027; if a judge quotes it, say the present tense on that page is wrong and the future plan is fine.
questions.trap_zh: 把多層講成現在就有。Entrepreneurship 頁寫「genetic 與 membrane 的冗餘」並把自殺開關排在 2027；如果評審引用，就說那一頁的現在式寫錯了，未來計畫本身沒問題。
questions.basis: instructor's priority set, 30 Oct read-through of Results, Hardware and Plants

questions.q_en: Through the whole project, which experts gave you the most valuable feedback, and how did they reshape the project?
questions.q_zh: 整個專案走下來，哪些專家給了你們最有價值的回饋？他們怎麼改變了這個專案？
kw_en: Chen: keep it in a vessel, sell the consumable
Chang: nothing drove the product across
kw_zh: 陳：留在容器裡、賣消耗品
張：沒有東西推產品過膜
questions.a_en: Professor Chen Wen-liang in April: he told us engineered bacteria released into open soil are hard to defend, so keep them in a vessel and sell the consumable rather than the device — that killed our transgenic rhizobacterium plan and is the reason a bioreactor exists at all. Dr. Jennifer Brophy then removed our kill switch, which made the membrane the containment and changed what the hardware has to monitor. Professor Chang Jo-Shu found the gap that would have sunk the first build: nothing in our design pushed the protectant from the lumen to the shell, because a higher flow rate only recirculates — hence the pinch valve, a smaller membrane, and the pressure and flow instruments that show fouling. And two reviewers changed things we had not asked about: Teacher He of Owl Lab replaced our two-board plan with one mainboard, which also ended the unstable pressure readings, and Dr. Peng voided one of our own hydroponic runs because culture volume was not standardised across arms.
questions.a_zh: 四月的陳文亮教授：他告訴我們「放到開放土壤裡的基改菌很難辯護，所以把它留在容器裡，賣消耗品而不是賣機器」——這句話殺掉了我們的轉基因根圈菌計畫，也正是為什麼今天會有一台生物反應器。接著 Jennifer Brophy 博士拿掉了我們的自殺開關，這讓膜成為圍阻本身，也改變了硬體需要監看什麼。張嘉修教授找出了會讓第一版報廢的缺口：我們的設計裡沒有任何東西把保護蛋白從 lumen 推到 shell，因為提高流速只是讓液體循環——於是有了夾管閥、更小的膜，以及顯示結垢的壓力與流量儀器。還有兩位審閱者改掉了我們根本沒問的東西：貓頭鷹實驗室的何老師把我們的雙板設計換成一塊主板，順手終結了壓力讀值不穩的問題；而彭博士因為各組培養液體積沒有統一，判定我們自己一次水耕實驗作廢。
questions.trap_en: Listing names without the before and after. Pair every expert with one concrete change, and include Dr. Peng voiding our own run — a judge rates that higher than praise.
questions.trap_zh: 只列名字而沒有前後對照。每一位專家都要配一個具體的改變，而且要包含彭博士判定我們自己的實驗作廢——評審看重這個勝過讚美。
